content.text:
I'm designing three example pairs showing hollow squares with noise added, where the transformation removes noise from the background while keeping the square shape intact. I'm sketching out the first grid, a 7x9 layout with a color-3 square bordered by scattered noise pixels.

Now I'm working on the second pair, using two same-colored squares of different sizes on an 11-wide grid, each speckled with noise dots to be cleaned up.

For the third pair I'm planning a single 6x6 square in a color-5 square within an 8x8 grid, again with noise pixels scattered around it.
